mostWorthwhile.text: Building the reef partnership and then the coral reef was most worthwhile: the explanations connected symbiosis, mineral skeletons and habitat across generations.

leastWorthwhile.text: Creating coral and nursery waters felt less rewarding because neither result explained the transition.

surprise.text: The sea cave's hint that it might wait a long time for a visitor made an erosion detour feel like a hook for a later story.

arbitrary.text: Combining nursery waters with a reef made a useful coastal mosaic, but the connection was not obvious before the result; it was also the only offered combination.

continue.text: Yes. The cave's possible future visitor and the payoff of connecting living habitats make me curious what the world will produce next.
